messages:
Maria H: Heads-up: landing copy bakeoff tomorrow 10am PT. Focus: Hosted API hero, Dedicated capacity page, Private deployment page. Need hero variants (3 each), CTA routing, and webinar signup mapping. @Jonah K can you bring benchmark narrative draft? :calendar:

Jonah K: On it. I'll bring the benchmark one-pager comparing p95 latency & $/1M tokens for Hosted vs Dedicated w/ quantization assumptions. Will share link: https://redwood.hub/benchmarks/bakeoff-draft

Tara L: For hero variants — can we test 'Predictable latency, predictable costs' vs 'Ship fast, scale later'? want one belief-led option and one practical SRE-led option.

Sam G: Inbound routing idea: Hosted -> trial signup (auto-accept), Dedicated -> sales lead flow, Private -> request-a-demo + security questionnaire. Webinar signups should map to 'interested in Dedicated/Private' tag based on choices.

Kevin B: Suggested CTA mapping (short):
```
hosted -> /signup?utm=landing&product=hosted
dedicated -> /contact-sales?utm=landing&product=dedicated
private -> /enterprise-demo?utm=landing&product=private
webinar -> /webinar-register?utm=webinar
```
Also add hidden field `deploy_preference` for routing.

Maria H: Love that. Also need to confirm GA events & Drift integration. @marketing-bot can you pull existing conversion rates for hosted vs enterprise pages?

marketing-bot: Pull complete: hosted landing CR 6.2%, dedicated PL 0.9%, private demo form 0.45%. Avg time-on-page: hosted 1m20s, enterprise pages 2m05s.

Tara L: Copy note: For Private page, lead with compliance & network controls, but keep an accessible sentence about speed/cost so it doesn't read like only sales.

Jonah K: Benchmark narrative draft will include two charts + TL;DR paragraph. TL;DR: for short lived queries Hosted is cheapest; committed Dedicated wins at sustained high throughput; Private same perf as Dedicated with policy/SSO tradeoffs. I'll pin before meeting.

Sam G: Webinar planning: can we run 30-min demo + 15 Q&A, and collect a 1-line 'primary use case' from registrants to tag routes? also ask for cloud provider to inform solutioning.

Kevin B: Action items: Maria to finalize hero variants doc, Jonah to attach charts, Tara to write alt copy, Sam to wire routing form, me to implement UTMs. We'll review in 10am sync.

Maria H: Perfect. I'll post the final doc by 8:30am. Thanks team :rocket:
